text: Figure 8.4: Heap Memory Consumption The heap memory consumption also depends on the ECU, the software context and the hardware configuration. Due to the highly dynamic nature of heap memory one problem is the fragmentation of the available memory area. So in some cases there can be not enough memory allocated, even though the total amount of free heap memory is big enough, because the available memory space is not available contiguously .
